promptCommon: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE individual full-body 2D static videogame NPC sprite: a GUIDE OF THE DEEP ROOTS, Refuge des Veilleurs tribe, Yautja homeworld. TWO references: first official Stan Winston Predator head sets ABSOLUTE CINEMA YAUTJA SPECIES ANATOMY whenever face is visible; second supplied dark-jungle guide V37 sets tribe visual culture, realistic painterly finish, dark leaf-like overlapping slate armour, flexible black scale layers, indigo cloth, restrained cyan technical inlays and real route/climbing equipment. Create a genuinely new individual from design below, never reproduce the reference's body, outfit, tools, or composition. Individual proportions and shape of armour must visibly follow the design. STRICT head anatomy when exposed: broad alien domed cranium and orbital ridges, deep-set eyes, reptilian hide, FOUR DISTINCT EXTERNAL FLESHY MANDIBULAR LOBES arranged around a SEPARATE INNER TOOTHED MOUTH, two upper cheek mandibles with outward ivory tusks and two substantial lower mandibles with tusks curving UP. Calm partly open mouthparts so all four can be seen, not a roar. No human face, nose, lips, ears or chin; not two dangling tubes, not two fangs. THICK SCALP TENDRILS, not human hair. IF the individual design explicitly calls for a COMPLETE BIOMASK, use a genuine opaque Predator biomask hiding the whole face and every mandibular part, anatomically broad at skull; do not show fangs sticking through it. Reptilian clawed hands and full clawed feet. Three-quarter BODY facing RIGHT, face angled slightly back toward viewer, mildly high camera. Quiet standing field-guide pose, physically supported equipment and believable joint/contact anatomy. Full body and every tool tip inside portrait; aim generous 8 percent clear transparent space over head and below feet. Actual transparent PNG alpha; NO ground, floor, cast shadow, vignette, forest background, scenery, extra person, second figure, sheet, inset, text, readable symbols, logo, watermark or border. Keep lantern light only inside its enclosed glass, no halo or beam. No firearms, wrist blades, skulls or attack stance. ONE single-pose static sprite.

variants.design: A tall lean adult male deep-root guide with dark grey-green mottled hide, a broad flattened alien dome and many thick black scalp tendrils drawn into a long low bundle. Face exposed with all FOUR fleshy mandibles. Wears a layered charcoal shoulder shawl integrated with small slate-blue leaf plates, a short deep indigo wrap tunic, broad double climbing belt and dark segmented knee and shin guards. Holds a compact acoustic route-listening horn with both hands at lower chest height, instrument tip pointed downward and supported, not to the mouth. Quiet highly attentive stance.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE individual full-body 2D static videogame NPC sprite: a GUIDE OF THE DEEP ROOTS, Refuge des Veilleurs tribe, Yautja homeworld. TWO references: first official Stan Winston Predator head sets ABSOLUTE CINEMA YAUTJA SPECIES ANATOMY whenever face is visible; second supplied dark-jungle guide V37 sets tribe visual culture, realistic painterly finish, dark leaf-like overlapping slate armour, flexible black scale layers, indigo cloth, restrained cyan technical inlays and real route/climbing equipment. Create a genuinely new individual from design below, never reproduce the reference's body, outfit, tools, or composition. Individual proportions and shape of armour must visibly follow the design. STRICT head anatomy when exposed: broad alien domed cranium and orbital ridges, deep-set eyes, reptilian hide, FOUR DISTINCT EXTERNAL FLESHY MANDIBULAR LOBES arranged around a SEPARATE INNER TOOTHED MOUTH, two upper cheek mandibles with outward ivory tusks and two substantial lower mandibles with tusks curving UP. Calm partly open mouthparts so all four can be seen, not a roar. No human face, nose, lips, ears or chin; not two dangling tubes, not two fangs. THICK SCALP TENDRILS, not human hair. IF the individual design explicitly calls for a COMPLETE BIOMASK, use a genuine opaque Predator biomask hiding the whole face and every mandibular part, anatomically broad at skull; do not show fangs sticking through it. Reptilian clawed hands and full clawed feet. Three-quarter BODY facing RIGHT, face angled slightly back toward viewer, mildly high camera. Quiet standing field-guide pose, physically supported equipment and believable joint/contact anatomy. Full body and every tool tip inside portrait; aim generous 8 percent clear transparent space over head and below feet. Actual transparent PNG alpha; NO ground, floor, cast shadow, vignette, forest background, scenery, extra person, second figure, sheet, inset, text, readable symbols, logo, watermark or border. Keep lantern light only inside its enclosed glass, no halo or beam. No firearms, wrist blades, skulls or attack stance. ONE single-pose static sprite.
